program: Bilingual integrated primary care, behavioral health, dental care and pharmacy
priceScope: Matched FY2024 full annual recipient cost against partial integrated depression-care mechanism; other primary/dental/pharmacy benefits unknown, not portfolio or marginal-gift EV.
formula: Health = (N clinical patients × judged eligible subgroup × delivered dose × incremental mode share × average annual trial-reference QALY − full patient process harm) × local share. Patient health is not reduced by household grouping. Household resources jointly log net gains and full access costs; distinct payer loss localized once. Price =10C/(health+signed income).
what: Tepeyac provides bilingual primary care, mental health support, dentistry and pharmacy services in Denver.
Patients can receive short-term therapy, preventive and chronic-disease care in one clinic.
It accepts insurance and offers sliding fees without refusing care solely for inability to pay.
strengths: Matched2024 unique patient count and full original annual expense.
Integrated bilingual screening and6–12therapy sessions provide a concrete access mechanism.
Clinical patients and household resources remain separate, with active safety-net alternatives.
reservations: Unique patients do not identify completed depression treatment.
The trial utility reference comes from UK primary care, not local controlled outcomes.
Full clinic cost covers important primary, dental and pharmacy effects not quantified here.

sections.what: Tepeyac integrates bilingual primary care, behavioral health, dental care and pharmacy. Current behavioral health provides6–12sessions and case management plus referral to longer-term care. In2024 it served7,901unique patients across73zipcodes with35,438visits; service-line visits are not separate unique people.
sections.monitoring: Request unique behavioral patients, diagnoses and completed dose; clinical utility against active alternatives; patient after-tax resources, fees and access costs; actual residence and unrestricted marginal capacity. Keep primary, dental and pharmacy channels separate from overlapping behavioral patients.
sections.qualitative: The2024annual reports62%uninsured,22%public-insured and16%private-insured patients. Sliding fees and insurance enrollment can improve access but neither retail care value nor coverage approval is automatically net income. CADET randomized581 adults in UK primary care and found .02 incremental annual QALYs versus usual care, CI−.02,.06; Tepeyac's bilingual integrated model differs and recipient outcomes are unmeasured.
sections.cost: FYDec2024 full cost $18,893,488 includes $133,641 netted event expense. The7,901unique patient envelope is observed; .15depression-compatible share, .7transfer/delivery and .3incremental enhanced-care share are judgments. q=.02 uses the trial's average annual incremental utility; response1 avoids a second responder factor. The .15eligible envelope1185clients times .7delivery830roughly fits5427behavioral visits at6–12sessions but is not an observed completion count. Clinical health retains all patients; .85household grouping applies only to resources. Judged adult/caregiver $300net work resources require eligible completed successful additional care and biological response, after taxes, benefit withdrawal and work costs; no child wages. Positive gains receive .5overlap discount; all households retain $5access/time loss and all patients .0001process harm. Actual avoided copays are centralzero judgments, with payer-incidence sensitivity rather than retail medical charity income. Denver share .95isjudged;73zipcodes are not a residence audit. Whole clinic costs versus partial BHbenefits do not estimate portfolio EV. Three-year mean and functional-only expense sensitivities quantify cost-boundary and expansion-scale uncertainty.
sections.funding: Own donation page embeds an actual Blackbaud donor form, with no transaction. Legal LaClinicaTepeyacInc DBA Tepeyac EIN84-1285505. Current payment page accepts Medicaid/Medicare/private insurance and family-income-based sliding fees. HHS support and other safety-net clinics are public-provider alternatives, not all donation-funded capacity. New clinic expansion and financial scale do not establish a next-gift effect.

costScope: Full calendar2024 IRS recipient functional plus netted direct event expenses; new clinic scale and capital/recognized resource boundaries uncertain. Partial integrated BHbenefits only.
geography: Judged .95share of unique patients resident in ten-county Denver CBSA19740;73zipcodes and MetroDenver description support presence, not measured share.
counterfactual: Other safety-net primary care and covered providers, usual depression treatment, sliding fees and HHS-funded services without Tepeyac integration.
attribution: Judged .15depression-compatible subgroup,.7delivery-transfer and .3incremental enhanced-care share; .02trial-average utility is not recipient efficacy.
uncertainty: Eligibility, completion, active alternatives, clinical transfer, client residence, household grouping/resources and marginal gift capacity unmeasured. Other clinical channels unknown.
